general_information.Syllabus Name: Web layout design_Thiết kế giao diện WEB
general_information.Description: Students will continue developing design skills for web, with a focus on typography, UI design, and use digital design tools to create graphic elements and content. Emphasis will be on critical thinking, executing design strategies and concepts, and comprehensive creative solutions to design problems in the web and mobile space.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course. - Computer with some version of photograph editing software such as Photoshop, Microsoft Word for written assignments, and POWERPOINT for presentations - Have color papers, Color Pencils, scissors... - Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher 1 day after the course.

description: Students will continue developing design skills for web, with a focus on typography, UI design, and use digital design tools to create graphic elements and content. Emphasis will be on critical thinking, executing design strategies and concepts, and comprehensive creative solutions to design problems in the web and mobile space.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain the core principles of user experience (UX) design and identify key factors that attract users to a website. Formulate essential research questions that guide early-stage design decisions.
Conduct effective project planning through efficient meetings, clearly defined objectives, and a well-understood approval process.
Define and prioritize clear, actionable project requirements based on input from both business stakeholders and target users.
Research and analyze user needs, and integrate user perspectives throughout all stages of the design process.
Choose and utilize the tools and techniques that enable you to bring visual ideas to your project team quickly
Understand the fundamentals of design systems and apply them to maintain consistency across UI components, layouts, and styles.
Be able to use design tools to create clean and well-structured UI for common design patterns

assessments.Grading Guide: - Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. - Teacher give marks on student's student's Class participation and preparation only after the Portfolio submission.
Each group will be assigned a target audience for a selected product to build website.In phase 1, the group will go through 3 parts: 1. RESEARCH 2. DEFINE 3. IDEATE
